summary: Backend smoke test halted at auth/register. GET /api/meta works, but POST /api/auth/register returns 500 due to ObjectId leaking into response after insert_one, which blocks every downstream test (login/me/profiles/likes/gifts/dates/wallet/checkout/upload).
passed: GET /api/meta returns gifts catalog, coin packages, premium, video_rate=10, gift_commission=0.30, date_min_coins=500

failed.issue: 500 Internal Server Error. FastAPI response serialization fails: `ValueError: [TypeError("'ObjectId' object is not iterable"), TypeError('vars() argument must have __dict__ attribute')]`. Root cause: after `await db.users.insert_one(doc)` in server.py:203, motor mutates `doc` in place adding `_id` (ObjectId). The next line returns `{k: v for k, v in doc.items() if k != 'password'}` which still contains `_id`, and FastAPI's jsonable_encoder cannot serialize ObjectId.
failed.evidence: HTTP 500 on POST /api/auth/register with valid payload. Backend traceback in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log shows failure at fastapi/encoders.py -> ValueError: [TypeError("'ObjectId' object is not iterable")]. Body returned: 'Internal Server Error'.

failed.issue: Could not be tested because registration is broken. This includes /auth/login, /auth/me (GET+PATCH), /profiles, /likes, /matches, /conversations/*, /gifts/send, /videocalls/start, /dates/*, /wallet, /wallet/withdraw, /payments/checkout, /payments/status, /upload, /files.

action_items: Fix /api/auth/register response in backend/server.py:204: strip `_id` as well. Change `{k: v for k, v in doc.items() if k != 'password'}` to `{k: v for k, v in doc.items() if k not in ('password', '_id')}` (matches the pattern already used in /api/auth/login at line 211).

After fix, rerun full backend suite to validate register->login->me->profiles->likes/match->messages->gifts (70/30 split)->videocall->date booking min-coins->wallet->withdraw->stripe checkout->payments status->upload/download.
